articles.title: Employers Face Growing Cancer Care Gaps and Surging Costs Amid Lagging Precision Medicine Adoption
articles.summary: A new study reveals that self-funded employers are confronting a significant "cancer attention gap" as treatment costs surge and access to advanced precision care lags behind. This matters because cancer remains one of the largest drivers of catastrophic claims in employer-sponsored health plans, threatening corporate healthcare budgets. The key business implication is an urgent need for pharmacy benefits and plan management strategies that better integrate oncology navigation, manage specialty drug costs, and optimize targeted therapies to control employer spending.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Wellcentra and LaborForce Media Partner to Combat Plan Sponsor Drug Costs
articles.summary: Wellcentra and LaborForce Media have announced a strategic partnership aimed at helping self-funded plan sponsors navigate and mitigate escalating prescription drug expenditures. This alliance matters because rising specialty and brand-name drug prices continue to strain employer-sponsored health plans, demanding innovative cost-containment strategies. For business operations, this collaboration provides plan sponsors with enhanced educational resources and advisory tools to optimize pharmacy benefit management, improve plan performance, and better control long-term healthcare liabilities.
articles.source_line: Source: The National Law Review; Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:13:06 GMT
